dedupe_keys.name: data for the impact of air conditioning on residential electricity demand across world countries

description: Data for "The Impact of Air conditioning on Residential Electricity Demand across World Countries. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Enrica De Cian, Giacomo Fachetta (Ca' Foscari University of Venice). Data for replication of tables and figures in: Enrica De Cian, Giacomo Falchetta, Filippo Pavanello, Yasmin Romitti, Ian Sue Wing, "The Impact of Air conditioning on Residential Electricity Demand across World Countries" (2025) [Journal of Environmental Economics and Management] Replication code is here: https://github.com/FPavanello/acglobal For questions: pavanello@ifo.de (econometrics) and giacomo.falchetta@cmcc.it (projections). Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
